# tritonctl disk

Manage disks

Subcommands: list, show, resize

Usage: `tritonctl disk [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>`

## tritonctl disk list

List the disks of an instance

Alias: ls

Usage: `tritonctl disk list [OPTIONS] --instance <INSTANCE>`

- `--instance <INSTANCE>`: The instance (name, uuid, or prefix) (required)

## tritonctl disk show

Show one disk

Usage: `tritonctl disk show [OPTIONS] <ID>`

- `<ID>`: Disk name, uuid, or prefix
- `--instance <INSTANCE>`: The disk's instance (name, uuid, or prefix). Needed to find a disk by name

## tritonctl disk resize

Grow a disk's backing volume. Grow-only. A running guest sees the new capacity after a reboot (cloud-init then grows the filesystem)

Usage: `tritonctl disk resize [OPTIONS] --size <SIZE> <ID>`

- `<ID>`: Disk name, uuid, or prefix
- `--instance <INSTANCE>`: The disk's instance (name, uuid, or prefix). Needed to find a disk by name
- `--size <SIZE>`: New total size: `50G`, `512M`, or bytes. Larger than today's (required)
